suggested_order: cue-alexa is the simpler/faster engine (pure bash, ~12-26h). Build it first to validate the pattern.
cue-google second (bash + Python gRPC, longer GCP setup).
cue umbrella last — it only adds value once an engine exists on PATH to route to.
Within an engine, run EP-1..EP-8 strictly in order; each EP's acceptance gate must pass before advancing.
